self_time_mechanisms.name: Memory planning, schema and snapshot validation

same_pid_jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

region_attribution.scope: Complete recorded leaf PC distribution for these disjoint code ranges from the one existing CPU sample. No new process/samples, no official benchmark score or hardware retirement count.
region_attribution.analyzer_refinement: Identical source analyzer, only jit_sites.most_common(30) expanded to all recorded sites.

interpretation.scope: Optimization15 diagnosis only; accepted52. No holdout source/profile diagnosis or benchmark selection. No official timing samples/history entries.
interpretation.sample_scope: Owned warm checked-call residence includes output reset/drop, so sample shares are not exact frozen kernel timer shares. No retired instructions, IPC/cache or memory-traffic measurements are inferred.
interpretation.byte_binding: All14620 native bytes from the same sampled PID match the genuine accepted52 Object, including every annotated hot instruction/window. Warmup/final finite C values and complete frozen execution counters match.
interpretation.decision: The new fused producer/sum region has1.13% of complete sampled leaf PCs, while the existing two-row/two-column product k region has11.91%. The initial per-term expression-layout hypothesis is not selected as the next change. Investigate a general four-independent-row product register tile, sharing one right scalar/vector load and k control across four ordered accumulators. Retain two/one-row tails, column SIMD/tails, original +0/k order, separate multiply/add, full result buffers and all existing ownership/admission/publication/epilogue replay.

source_derived_product_work_on_original_.limit: Derived loop counts on unchanged admitted dimensions; not measured hardware events or a speedup forecast. Compiler rules must use general geometry and register bounds, never these dimensions or program names.

interpretation.remaining_costs: Allocation/free, planning and other runtime self time still dominate the full call. Kernel blocking is one concrete shared mechanism; no whole-program or generalization speedup is inferred. A materially changed fully qualified source gets one prospective optimization probe, then frozen formal evaluation under v4 only.
